metadata.title: MARES — Monitoring and Analysis of Marine Species Records
metadata.description: Platform for recording, querying and analyzing pathological data of stranded marine fauna.

common.tagline: Monitoring and Analysis of Marine Species Records
common.name: Name

requestAccess.title: Request access
requestAccess.description: To create an organization in MARES, submit a request. An administrator will review it and grant your access by email.
requestAccess.name: Your name
requestAccess.orgPlaceholder: e.g. Marine Animal Pathology Lab — UFSC
requestAccess.sentDescription: Your request has been recorded. You will receive an email with an access link once it is approved by an administrator.

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to create a new password.
forgotPassword.sentDescription: If an account exists for this email, we've sent a link for you to reset your password.

setPassword.title: Set password
setPassword.description: Choose a password to access MARES.
setPassword.success: Password set! You are now signed in.
setPassword.invalidDescription: This link is no longer valid. Request a new email to set your password.

noOrg.title: You don't belong to any organization
noOrg.description: Your account is not linked to an organization yet. Ask an administrator of your organization to add you, or wait for your access request to be approved. If you don't recognize this account, contact us to request the deletion of your profile.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.adminMode: You are in global administration mode.
dashboard.nextStepsDesc: The foundation is ready. Upcoming phases will add research, animal registration, the analysis grid, map and charts.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: Welcome to MARES. By requesting access or activating your account, you agree to the terms below, which govern the use of this platform for recording and analyzing pathological data of stranded marine fauna.
terms.acceptLabel: I have read and accept the <link>Terms of Use</link>

data.title: 1. Data and purpose
data.body: The data recorded is intended for scientific research on marine fauna. Each organization is responsible for the data it enters and for ensuring authorization to collect and process it.

usage.title: 2. Platform use
usage.body: Access is personal and non-transferable. You agree to keep your credentials confidential and to use the platform only for legitimate research and conservation purposes.

privacy.title: 3. Privacy
privacy.body: We collect only the data required to operate the service (name, email and organization memberships). We do not share your personal data with third parties without a legal basis.

responsibility.title: 4. Responsibilities
responsibility.body: The accuracy of scientific data is the responsibility of whoever records it. The platform is provided as is, without guarantees of uninterrupted availability.

changes.title: 5. Changes
changes.body: These terms may be updated. When that happens, you may be asked to accept them again on your next sign-in. The date of the current version is shown at the top of this page.

members.title: Members
members.addMemberDesc: If the email already has an account, it is simply linked. Otherwise, we send an invite — provide the name.
members.selfDemoted: You are no longer an administrator
members.leaveDesc: Do you want to leave this organization? If you are the only administrator and there is no data, the organization will be deleted.
members.demoteDesc: Do you want to step down from administrator to researcher? You will lose access to member management.
members.promoteDesc: Make {email} an administrator of the organization? They will manage members and org data.
members.editOrgDesc: Update the organization's name and location.

myOrgs.title: My organizations
myOrgs.subtitle: Organizations you belong to. You can leave any of them at any time.
myOrgs.empty: You don't belong to any organization.
myOrgs.leaveDescAdmin: Do you want to leave? If you are the only administrator and the organization has no data, it will be deleted.

adminRequests.title: Access requests
